verdict.rationale: Playground-style inference is fully reachable through the API: chat, streaming, structured outputs, tool calling, image inputs, reasoning effort and batch. A documented Management API also covers dedicated-endpoint model upload and deployment, and dedicated endpoints expose Prometheus metrics. However, the Cloud Console is described as the place for managing projects, API keys, usage, billing and team access, and nothing shows those functions are exposed via API; no OpenAPI spec was found either. Missing for 10: API equivalents for project, API-key, usage, billing and team management; a published OpenAPI spec; independent confirmation of UI/API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to your [dedicated endpoint](/dedicated/overview).
The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously
Monitor your dedicated inference endpoints with Prometheus-compatible metrics for requests, tokens, latency, and endpoint health.
The Cerebras API supports streaming responses
